answer_1.quote: We demonstrate ADACAD's effectiveness on a diverse range of tasks, covering question-answering (QA) and summarization, with six QA datasets ... and three summarization datasets (CNN-DM, XSum, and TofuEval).
answer_1.outputs: generated answers for QA and generated summaries for summarization

answer_2.quote: We report exact match accuracy on all QA datasets. We use two reference-based metrics, ROUGE-L and BERT-P, to evaluate summarization quality. ... we use AlignScore to measure the factual consistency of summaries.
